name: marketingskills
description: A comprehensive set of marketing skills tailored for Claude Code and AI agents, enabling capabilities in conversion rate optimization (CRO), copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.

inputs.name: marketing_goals
inputs.description: High-level marketing objectives or targets to guide strategy and execution.

inputs.name: content_brief
inputs.description: Outline or details for copywriting and content creation tasks.

inputs.name: website_data
inputs.description: Analytic data and user behavior metrics from digital platforms.

inputs.name: seo_keywords
inputs.description: Target keywords for search engine optimization.

inputs.name: growth_metrics
inputs.description: Key performance indicators relevant to growth engineering efforts.

outputs.name: optimized_content
outputs.description: Copy crafted to improve engagement, SEO, and conversions.

outputs.name: seo_analysis_report
outputs.description: Insights and recommendations for improving search engine ranking.

outputs.name: conversion_rate_recommendations
outputs.description: Actionable suggestions for enhancing CRO based on data analysis.

outputs.name: growth_strategy
outputs.description: Strategic plan designed to drive user acquisition and retention.

outputs.name: analytics_dashboard
outputs.description: Aggregated visual and data reports summarizing marketing performance.

steps: Define marketing objectives and target audience with inputs provided
Generate or optimize content using AI-driven copywriting tools
Analyze website and marketing data for actionable insights
Perform SEO analysis and keyword integration to improve ranking
Develop and recommend CRO tactics based on data patterns
Formulate and iterate growth strategies with measurable KPIs
Aggregate results into dashboards and reports for ongoing monitoring
use_cases: Enhancing website conversion rates through optimized content and UX adjustments
Automating copywriting tasks for marketing campaigns targeting specific audiences
Improving SEO rankings by analyzing keywords and on-page content
Building growth strategies for startups to accelerate user acquisition
Generating analytics reports to monitor and adapt marketing performance
patterns: Iterative testing and analysis for CRO

prompt_templates.name: seo_content_creation
prompt_templates.template: Create an SEO-optimized article on {topic} that targets the following keywords: {seo_keywords}. The article should be engaging and drive conversions.

prompt_templates.name: conversion_rate_improvement
prompt_templates.template: Analyze the following website data and suggest actionable strategies to improve the conversion rate: {website_data}.

prompt_templates.name: growth_strategy_development
prompt_templates.template: Develop a growth strategy for a company in the {industry} sector focusing on metrics: {growth_metrics}.

prompt_templates.name: marketing_campaign_copy
prompt_templates.template: Write persuasive marketing copy based on this brief: {content_brief}, aimed at achieving these goals: {marketing_goals}.

prompt_templates.name: analytics_report_summary
prompt_templates.template: Provide a summary and insights from this marketing analytics data: {analytics_data}.
